core_obligations: Read the hypotheses (statement with the proof): each object of the site is covered by members of B, and for each member V there is an integer d_V and a cofinal system of coverings over which the cohomology of the cohomology sheaves vanishes in the stated range.

Apply the companion criterion (proof lines 5411-5413): the author sets p(V, m) = d_V + max(0, m), which makes the vanishing range of the companion lemma exactly the range assumed here, so the companion result gives that the canonical map is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Match the per-object vanishing hypothesis with the shape required by the companion criterion.
Define the bounding function p(V, m) = d_V + max(0, m) and apply that criterion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma recovers an object of the derived category as the derived limit of its truncations from a per-object vanishing bound: for every member V of a covering family there is an integer d_V and a cofinal system of coverings over which the cohomology of the cohomology sheaves vanishes above d_V in the negative degrees (statement lines 5391-5409). The proof is short and explicit: the author exhibits the bounding function p(V, m) = d_V + max(0, m) for which the hypothesis becomes exactly that of the companion criterion, and applies it (proof lines 5411-5413). The non-formal content is the choice of the bounding function. The claim is H2: one explicit reduction to a companion criterion.
